source.name: FC Shakhtar: Shakhtar and BETON: new title sponsor of the club
source.note: Three-year title-sponsorship contract beginning May 3, 2026. No fee reported by the club or the press checked; value unknown.
source.quote: Under the terms of the three-year contract, the brand receives the status of the club's title sponsor. The partnership officially begins on May 3, 2026

note: Title sponsor of FC Shakhtar; first worn in the Ukrainian Clasico on May 3, 2026.
